standard.summary: 控制中间 checkpoint 的保存逻辑：all = 保存所有步的 checkpoint；best = 只保留验证 loss 最低的；last_n = 保留最近 N 个（配合 save_last_n_steps）。
standard.effect: best 模式需要评估集，自动选择最优步数的权重保存；last_n 是最常用的节省磁盘空间方式。
standard.whenToUse: 磁盘空间有限时选择 last_n（配合 save_last_n_steps=3~5）；有评估集时 best 模式可自动选择最优点。
standard.avoidWhen: LoRA 训练通常没有独立评估集，best 模式对 LoRA 意义有限（使用预览图目测选择更实用）。

optionDescriptions.auto: 梯度检查点策略自动选（不是存盘策略）。
optionDescriptions.off: 不做梯度检查点，最快，峰值显存最高。
optionDescriptions.full: 大段重算换显存，反向最慢。
optionDescriptions.offloaded: 激活卸到 CPU 一类地方，GPU 省、PCIe 忙。
optionDescriptions.selective: 轻的重算、重的留着，折中。

standard_en.summary: Governs how intermediate checkpoints are kept: all = keep every step's checkpoint; best = keep only the lowest validation loss; last_n = keep the most recent N (together with save_last_n_steps).
standard_en.effect: best needs an evaluation set and saves the weights from the best step automatically; last_n is the usual way to save disk space.
standard_en.whenToUse: Choose last_n when disk space is limited (with save_last_n_steps=3-5); with an evaluation set, best picks the optimum for you.
standard_en.avoidWhen: LoRA training usually has no separate evaluation set, so best is of limited use there -- judging by preview images is more practical.

optionDescriptions.auto: Picks the gradient-checkpointing policy automatically (this is not the save policy).
optionDescriptions.off: No gradient checkpointing: fastest, with the highest peak VRAM.
optionDescriptions.full: Recomputes large spans to buy VRAM; the slowest backward.
optionDescriptions.offloaded: Moves activations to the CPU or similar: easy on the GPU, busy on PCIe.
optionDescriptions.selective: Recomputes the cheap parts and keeps the expensive ones -- a compromise.

advanced.principle: checkpoint_policy 影响 checkpoint 管理器的行为：all = 写出所有 checkpoint 不删除（磁盘空间最大占用）；last_n = 写出后检查总数并删除超限的旧 checkpoint。
advanced.tradeoffs: 若训练意外中断，last_n 模式下只能从最近 N 个 checkpoint 恢复；all 模式可以从任意 checkpoint 恢复但磁盘占用极高。

advanced_en.principle: checkpoint_policy shapes the checkpoint manager's behavior: all = write every checkpoint and delete none (largest disk usage); last_n = after writing, check the total and delete older checkpoints beyond the limit.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: If training is interrupted unexpectedly, last_n mode can only resume from the most recent N checkpoints; all mode can resume from any checkpoint but uses a lot of disk.
